author_reading.rationale: The clk_a phase register generates a one-cycle pulse every two source cycles, and clk_b captures it directly with no synchronizer. Reset is synchronous to each domain.

rationale: pulse_a is high for one source cycle every two cycles and directly captured in asynchronous clk_b with no metastability containment. Its 10 ns high interval can fall between 13 ns destination edges, losing an event. Domain-local reset contracts do not repair this capture.

labels.rationale: pulse_a toggles every source cycle in steady operation and is directly sampled by a single asynchronous destination register. A high pulse lasts 10 time units while clk_b has period 13, so events can be missed even without metastability. There is no event synchronization, stretching or acknowledgement. Resets have local declared domains; unspecified startup does not remove the steady-state defect.
